description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity called RelinquishIdentityActivity that provides a UI for creating new documents, with specific intent flags to manage task identities in the Android system.

classes.name: RelinquishIdentityActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages relinqishing its task identity and creates new document intents with specific flags for task management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets its content view.

methods.name: createNewDocument
methods.description: Handles the click event to create a new document by starting a new activity with the appropriate intent.

methods.name: newDocumentIntent
methods.description: Constructs and returns an Intent object to launch NewDocumentActivity as a new document in recents, with flags to launch in a new task and multiple tasks.
